user_story:
As a user, I want to be able to log in to the application using my credentials so that I can access my account and use the features of the application. 
Acceptance Criteria:
1. When I enter a valid username 'standard_user' in the input with data-test='username' and a valid password 'secret_sauce' in the input with data-test='password', clicking the button with data-test='login-button' should successfully log me in and redirect me to the homepage.
2. If I attempt to log in with an empty username and password, the URL should remain the same, and I should see the login form with the input fields still visible.
